holds.reason: The Shanghai Stock Exchange identifies the underlying data centre and its appraisal specifies 558 Yuanchuang Road. A different GDS property lies immediately to its west. No independently reproducible site-specific numeric locator was established.

holds.candidate: Guangdong Data Centres 1, 2 and 3, Heshan Bluesea Intelligence Valley
holds.reason: The land-company filing supplies a campus-centre coordinate and the owner identifies three buildings. The September property table gives lease type, occupancy and completion year. It has no dated observation of physical hosting within the individual buildings. The August 11 municipal report covers the tenant operation at the broader campus.

holds.candidate: MC Digital Realty NRT10 and NRT14, Inzai
holds.reason: The Japanese operator explicitly announced NRT14 opening on April 8 and retrospectively identifies NRT10. Its undated facility roster describes all three sites as operating in 2026. A day-precision current named observation was not established for NRT10 or NRT14. NRT12 remains a separate project at the atlas block-4 campus.

EcoDC’s September consultation document names the parcel Gävle Norrsundet 2:230 and depicts the proposed facility area in Figure 6-1. SMHI’s signed October 5 response confirms the dated consultation. The figure contains no numerical coordinates or georeferencing. The 69-entry county environmental register for Gävle identifies the harbour, mill and water works at Norrsundet but has no EcoDC project entry. A separate proposed nuclear installation occupies 15:28. No reusable authoritative coordinate or machine-readable boundary for the data-centre area was verified.
holds.technical_scope: The consultation describes phased commercial colocation and estimates 150 MW of electrical demand. The much larger backup combustion input ceiling is a separate measure.
